1.text: Samweli amaze gusaza, agira abahungu be abacamanza b'Abisirayeli.

2.text: Imfura ye yitwaga Yoweli, uw'ubuheta yitwaga Abiya. Bari abacamanza b'i Bērisheba.

3.text: Ariko abahungu be ntibagendana ingeso nk'ize, ahubwo bakiyobagiriza gukunda ibintu, bagahongerwa, bagaca urwa kibera.

4.text: Nuko abakuru ba Isirayeli bose baherako baraterana, basanga Samweli i Rama.

5.text: Baramubwira bati “Dore uri umusaza kandi abahungu bawe ntibagendana ingeso nk'izawe, none rero utwimikire umwami ajye aducira imanza nk'ayandi mahanga yose.”

6.text: Ariko iryo jambo ribabaza Samweli ubwo bavugaga bati “Uduhe umwami wo kujya aducira imanza.” Nuko Samweli abitura Uwiteka.

7.text: Maze Uwiteka abwira Samweli ati “Emerera abo bantu ibyo bagusabye byose kuko atari wowe banze, ahubwo ni jye banze ngo ntaba umwami wabo.

8.text: Barakugenza nk'uko bajyaga bangenza muri byose, uhereye umunsi nabakuriye muri Egiputa ukageza ubu. Baranyimūye bakorera izindi mana.

9.text: Nuko none ubemerere, ariko ubahamirize cyane, ubasobanurire uburyo umwami uzabategeka uko azabagenza.”

10.text: Nuko Samweli asobanurira abantu bamusabye umwami amagambo y'Uwiteka yose.

11.text: Aravuga ati “Uku ni ko umwami uzabategeka azabagenza: azatora abahungu banyu abatoraniriza gukora iby'amagare ye no kuba abo kugendera ku mafarashi be, azabagira abasibanira imbere y'amagare ye.

12.text: Kandi azabatoraniriza kuba abatware b'abantu igihumbi n'ab'abantu mirongo itanu, abandi azabagira abahinzi be n'abasaruzi be, n'abacuzi b'intwaro zo kurwanisha n'ab'ibyuma by'amagare ye.

13.text: Kandi azatorera abakobwa banyu gukora imibavu, no kuba abatetsi n'abavuzi b'imitsima.

14.text: Kandi azatora imirima yanyu n'inzabibu zanyu n'imyelayo yanyu, ibiruta ibindi ubwiza abihe abagaragu be.

15.text: Kandi azabaka amakoro y'igice kimwe mu icumi cy'imbuto zanyu n'icy'inzabibu zanyu, ayahe abatware be n'abagaragu be.

16.text: Kandi azabanyaga abagaragu banyu n'abaja banyu, n'amatungo yanyu y'inyamibwa n'indogobe zanyu, abikoreshe imirimo ye.

17.text: Azenda igice kimwe mu icumi cy'amatungo yanyu, kandi muzaba abagaragu be.

18.text: Maze uwo munsi muzaborozwa n'uwo mwami mwitoranirije, ariko uwo munsi nta cyo Uwiteka azabasubiza.”

19.text: Ariko abantu banga kumvira Samweli baravuga bati “Biramaze, turashaka umwami wo kudutegeka

20.text: kugira ngo natwe duse n'andi mahanga yose, umwami wacu ajye aducira imanza, ajye atujya imbere aturengere mu ntambara zacu.”

21.text: Nuko Samweli amaze kumva amagambo y'abo bantu yose, abisubiriramo Uwiteka uko bingana.

22.text: Uwiteka asubiza Samweli ati “Bumvire, ubimikire umwami.”Nuko Samweli abwira Abisirayeli ati “Umuntu wese nasubire mu mudugudu w'iwabo.”
